title: The Ark Captured

questions.question: Who defeated Israel, prompting the ark’s use?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 4:1-2 (ESV): “...Israel was defeated before the Philistines...”

questions.question: Who died carrying the ark into battle?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 4:11 (ESV): “And the ark of God was captured, and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, died.”

questions.question: How did Eli die upon hearing the news?
options: Fell off his seat and broke his neck
questions.correctAnswer: Fell off his seat and broke his neck
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 4:18 (ESV): “...Eli fell over backward from his seat... and his neck was broken and he died...”

questions.question: What did Phinehas’s wife name her son?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 4:21 (ESV): “And she named the child Ichabod, saying, ‘The glory has departed from Israel!’...”

questions.question: Why did Israel bring the ark to the battle?
options: That it might save them from their enemies
questions.correctAnswer: That it might save them from their enemies
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 4:3 (ESV): "...let us bring the ark... that it may come among us and save us from the power of our enemies."

questions.question: Where was the initial battle camp of Israel located?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 4:1 (ESV): "...They encamped at Ebenezer, and the Philistines encamped at Aphek."

questions.question: How did the Philistines react when the ark arrived in Israel’s camp?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 4:7 (ESV): "The Philistines were afraid, for they said, 'A god has come into the camp.'..."

questions.question: How many foot soldiers of Israel fell in the second battle?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 4:10 (ESV): "...So the people of Israel fled... and there fell of Israel 30,000 foot soldiers."

questions.question: How old was Eli when he died?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 4:15 (ESV): "Now Eli was ninety-eight years old and his eyes were set so that he could not see."

questions.question: From where did the messenger come who reported the news to Eli?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 4:12 (ESV): "A man of Benjamin ran from the battle line and came to Shiloh the same day..."

questions.question: What does Ichabod mean?
options: Where is the glory? / No glory
questions.correctAnswer: Where is the glory? / No glory
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 4:21 (ESV): "...saying, 'The glory has departed from Israel!'..." (Footnote: Ichabod means Where is the glory? or There is no glory).

questions.question: How long had Eli judged Israel?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 4:18 (ESV): "...He had judged Israel forty years."

questions.question: The Philistines cried out, "Woe to us! Who can deliver us from the power of these mighty gods? These are the gods who struck the ______ with every sort of plague in the wilderness."
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 4:8 (ESV): "...These are the gods who struck the Egyptians with every sort of plague in the wilderness."

questions.question: What condition was the messenger in when he arrived?
options: Clothes torn and dirt on his head
questions.correctAnswer: Clothes torn and dirt on his head
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 4:12 (ESV): "...with his clothes torn and dirt on his head."

questions.question: Phinehas's wife died during what event?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 4:19-20 (ESV): "...she bowed her head and gave birth, for her pains came upon her. And... as she was dying..."

key_verse_text: And she said, “The glory has departed from Israel, for the ark of God has been captured.” (ESV)
